bounded_contexts.name: Connectivity Requirements
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Connectivity-need identity/lifecycle, required semantic interaction, applicability and justification/provenance.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Authoritative Access Rule identity, uniqueness/idempotency, properties, Active/Inactive, connectivity-decision consumption and desired-policy projections.

bounded_contexts.name: Authority Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Scoped authority for domain actions by scope/effective time, including assignment, delegation, transfer/revocation and accountability.

bounded_contexts.name: Resource Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Access-domain Resource/Endpoint identity and current/historical technical realization.

bounded_contexts.name: Application Communication Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Application/Component/Deployment/DCS communication semantics and structural validity.

bounded_contexts.name: Technical Access Evidence
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Normalized source-qualified technical access evidence with provenance/time/freshness/coverage.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy Realization
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Technical-to-domain correspondence, enforcement-policy derivation and desired-vs-configured reconciliation.

invariants: Bounded Context is not a deployment unit.
Connectivity need does not authorize access.
Technical evidence does not authorize access.
Access Policy owns authoritative Access Rule identity and operational state.
Technical realization changes do not redefine Rule semantic identity.
